mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analytics_visits (visitor_id, session_id, path, referrer, user_agent, created_at) VALUES (#{visitorId}, #{sessionId}, #{path}, #{referrer}, #{userAgent}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(referrer, ''), '(прямой переход)') AS path, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM analytics_visits WHERE created_at >= #{since} AND referrer IS NOT NULL AND referrer != ''
GROUP BY path ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM analytics_visits WHERE created_at >= #{since} AND (referrer IS NULL OR referrer = '')

SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 10) AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS views FROM analytics_visits WHERE created_at >= #{since}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT session_id FROM analytics_visits WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY MAX(created_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
